items.prompt: A realistic close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman in her early 20s, with fair smooth skin, delicate facial features, large expressive dark brown eyes with long natural lashes and subtle eyeliner, soft arched eyebrows, a small straight nose, and full soft pink lips slightly parted in a calm neutral expression. She has long, slightly wavy dark brown-black hair cascading over her shoulders and partially framing her face, with soft volume and natural texture. Her head is tilted slightly to the side, resting her right cheek gently against the back of her hand with fingers lightly curled near her face in a relaxed, contemplative pose. She is wearing a simple black long-sleeve top or hoodie. Soft indoor lighting creates gentle highlights on her skin and hair, with a warm neutral tone. Background is a dark brown leather or fabric couch/sofa, slightly out of focus. Photorealistic style, high detail on skin texture, hair strands, and facial features, natural makeup look (subtle blush, glossy lips), shallow depth of field, intimate selfie-like composition, soft cinematic lighting.
